data.notes_barbara:
Different products; Different customers; Different business model

Freshpet sells pet food through retailers. Its pet-owner market differs from Wendy’s restaurant customers.
data.notes_matthew: Freshpet sells refrigerated dog and cat food through retailers. Different customer, different product, nothing in common with Wendy's.

data.reason: Wendy's sells prepared hamburgers and fast food to consumers through franchised and company-operated restaurants. Freshpet makes refrigerated dog and cat food and sells it through grocery, mass, club and pet specialty retailers and online. The products differ (restaurant meals vs pet food). The customers differ (diners vs pet owners and retailers). The business models differ (restaurant franchising and royalties vs manufacturing and wholesale).
Different customers: Freshpet provides pet food and customized dog meal plans to pet owners; Wendy's provides restaurant meals for people.

P1.1.text: All Natural Dog Food - Fresh Food for Dogs - Freshpet

P1.2.text: Fresh dog and cat food made with all-natural chicken or beef as the #1 ingredient. Refrigerated, preservative-free & trusted by pet parents!

P1.3.text: free welcome kit & free shipping on every order! free welcome kit & free shipping always!

P1.4.text: healthy food, fresh from the fridge ™

P1.6.text: All-natural, farm-raised poultry, beef, or fish.

P1.7.text: Steam-cooked to preserve nutrients and lock-in freshness.

P1.8.text: Everything about your pet is totally unique—including their nutritional needs. Developed by veterinary nutritionists, explore our fresh family of brands to discover what’s perfect for your pet. And, we deliver! Freshpet has a dog food subscription plan to make life simpler.

P1.9.text: Our signature recipes. Healthy, delicious meals made with fresh, high-quality ingredients.

P1.10.text: Clean nutrition. Simple ingredients with proven health benefits.

P1.11.text: Deliciousness delivered. Meal plans customized for your pet, fresh to your door.

P1.12.text: Home-cooked goodness. Tasty ready-to-serve meals, from our kitchens to yours.

P1.13.text: A smarter snack. Craveable protein-rich treats you can feel good about.

P1.14.text: Stock up on your pup’s favorites. Protein-rich, high-quality meals, available at Costco.

P1.15.text: get customized freshpet meal plans delivered

P1.16.text: Enjoy free shipping on every order - plus earn Freshpet Rewards with every loyalty milestone!

P1.17.text: Each recipe and meal plan is created to meet your dog’s health and wellness goals.

P1.18.text: the most personalized way to feed fresh

P1.19.text: Take the guesswork out of feeding. With our customized meal plan, you’ll always have the right amount of food on hand.

P1.20.text: enjoy amazing perks and rewards when you subscribe to Freshpet Custom Meals®

P1.21.text: Freshpet earns the Clean Label Project Purity Award

P1.22.text: Freshpet has received Clean Label Project’s Purity Award across our portfolio, which means our recipes meet their highest purity standard based on independent testing for contaminants. Clean Label Project is a non-profit that tests products beyond traditional food safety standards looking for “hidden” contaminants such as heavy metals (e.g., lead, mercury, arsenic, cadmium) as well as pesticides and plasticizers.

P1.23.text: Our nutrient-packed recipes are meticulously crafted by our board-certified veterinary nutritionists.

P1.25.text: loving the planet we all share

P1.26.text: We believe in respecting the planet and treating the natural resources we share with care. This is why we never stop pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. And, while we know we’re not perfect, we do all we can to lessen our environmental impact while giving pets the freshest, healthiest food.

P1.28.text: loved by millions of happy eaters

P1.29.text: The excitement for the product is evident, it is devoured in minutes! My dogs have beautiful coats, clear eyes, no digestive or skin issues, are an ideal weight, and are happy & healthy. They have never had diarrhea or thrown up. I keep waiting for that to happen. I attribute it to the quality ingredients and the care that Freshpet puts into their product.

P1.30.text: We absolutely LOVE these treats! Meenie (aka "Puppy Girl") is 14 and she is the most pickiest eater we have ever had, but this she LOVES! She has always been slightly picky. We have also switched her to the Home Cooked Chicken Recipe for her breakfast and dinner. I swear it has given her more energy... She is almost puppy-like again when she gets treats! Meenie says "Yes mommy and daddy, tell everyone they are yummy!"

P1.31.text: I have a Maltese who is very picky and has skin allergies. This food is amazing, he loves it as a topper to his dry kibble and finally looks forward to eating! I'm very happy and so is he!

P1.32.text: Finally a treat my dogs will do anything for

P1.33.text: I bought this treat not thinking
